questiontext.text: What is an open-plan office layout?

answer.text: An office built outdoors in a public park without a roof

feedback.text: Incorrect. An open-plan office features an expansive single hall with shared space and visual openness.

questiontext.text: Which of the following is a major advantage of an open-plan office?

generalfeedback.text: Open-plan offices eliminate expensive walls and allow supervisors to monitor staff easily.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Open-plan offices eliminate expensive walls and allow supervisors to monitor staff easily.

answer.text: Lower construction and rental costs and easier staff supervision

Incorrect. Open-plan offices eliminate expensive walls and allow supervisors to monitor staff easily.

questiontext.text: What is a serious disadvantage of an open-plan office layout?

generalfeedback.text: Acoustic distractions and lack of privacy are the primary drawbacks of open layouts.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Acoustic distractions and lack of privacy are the primary drawbacks of open layouts.

answer.text: Constant noise, ringing telephones, and lack of confidentiality for sensitive discussions

feedback.text: Correct! Acoustic distractions and lack of privacy are the primary drawbacks of open layouts.
Incorrect. Acoustic distractions and lack of privacy are the primary drawbacks of open layouts.

questiontext.text: What is a closed (private or cellular) office layout?

generalfeedback.text: Closed offices provide separate partitioned rooms with doors for individuals or small units.

answer.text: A room that is permanently locked and never entered by humans

feedback.text: Incorrect. Closed offices provide separate partitioned rooms with doors for individuals or small units.

feedback.text: Correct! Closed offices provide separate partitioned rooms with doors for individuals or small units.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Closed offices provide separate partitioned rooms with doors for individuals or small units.
Incorrect. Closed offices provide separate partitioned rooms with doors for individuals or small units.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Confidential discussions and sensitive legal/HR records require privacy to prevent unauthorized disclosures.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Confidential discussions and sensitive legal/HR records require privacy to prevent unauthorized disclosures.
